newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse resumes trade on merging firms.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse resumes trade on merging firms.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Friday lifted the morning share trade suspension of CMIC Finance and Securities Plc, Thaimex Finance and Securities Plc and Nava Finance and Securities Plc after the firms clarified their merger plan.
The three firms on Thursday signed a memorandum of understanding to merge and to apply for a new commercial banking licence.
The Thai bourse said the three finance firms were allowed to resume trading in the Friday afternoon session after they briefed the exchange on their alliance plan.
The exchange, however, warned investors and shareholders of the finance companies to exercise caution in trading the issues and to follow progress of the planned merger.
Nava and Thaimex are affiliates of Thai Military Bank Plc.
The central bank has given its blessing for Thailand's 91 finance and securities firms to boost competitiveness through mergers.
